company.name: CarSoug
company.shortDescription: Car Soug is a leading Saudi based online market place for used cars. It is supports end-to-end online acquisition of cars
company.description: CarSoug is a Saudi based startup in the process of building an end-to-end online market place catering for the entire life cycle of cars. It includes car research and news, offers for new cars, listing of used cars, history reports, used cars prices validation, cars insurance, cars financing, end users reviews and ratings. The platform intends to provide its services to both dealers as well as regular users who are looking to buy or sell their cars or those who are looking for maintenance and support services.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform for buying and selling used cars in Saudi Arabia, supporting end-to-end car acquisition.
